items.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Then I joined Lucky Millinder’s band. ... I used to be – when I was in the band for a time, I was the straw boss. I used to rehearse the band for him.

ctx.x: Is that when you – here I’ve got Lucky Millinder, or maybe it was Sam Donahue?
I joined Herbie Fields’s band. Then I left them and went with Sam Donahue, and played with Sam just a short time. Then I joined Lucky Millinder’s band.
In Sam Donahue’s band, were there any other blacks in that band?

items.title: Joe Wilder Part 2 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 12, 1998
items.q: Lucky Millinder, yeah... We were in South Carolina... I think six of the members of the band were white... Lucky said, 'I am.'

ctx.x: You had told me about an incident with one of the bands you were with in the south, I think it was South Carolina?
Yes. And it was the first time you’d been down there with an integrated band?
